r1.exp: 1=C (Cheryl: 'HOPEFULLY HANGING AROUND BY THE PHOTOCOPIER or ENTHUSIASTICALLY CARRYING TRAYS OF COFFEE' = sarkazam). 2=F (Forrest: 'not a clue about what I was going to do from one day to the next'). 3=E (Elaine: 'Far from the deceptive holiday image of self-indulgent sunburnt teenage backpackers'). 4=D (Dominic: 'makes writing a dissertation and academic deadlines seem more manageable'). 5=A (Annabelle: 'it can become an ESCAPE FROM RESPONSIBILITY'). 6=C (Cheryl: 'government announcing it is going to RAISE UNIVERSITY FEES... number of young people taking a gap year is expected to FALL DRAMATICALLY'). 7=A (Annabelle: 'it has become the privilege of the AFFLUENT FEW – THUS CREATING ANOTHER GAP'). 8=B (Bradley: 'gap year spent volunteering or gaining work experience makes your JOB APPLICATION STAND OUT'). 9=E (Elaine: 'it's been forgotten that the major point of volunteer trips is to BENEFIT THE COMMUNITY'). 10=D (Dominic: 'Attend PREDEPARTURE EDUCATION PROGRAMMES'). 11=F (Forrest: 'your initial dismay at the ABSENCE OF THE INTERNET... will turn into a REWARDING EXCUSE TO CUT YOURSELF OFF FROM THE NEWS'). 12=C (Cheryl: 'I SPENT MINE LOOKING FOR AN EXCUSE TO RETURN HOME').

r13.exp: 'It is the NOVEL CONCEPT OF VERTICAL LAYERED STRUCTURES that will REVOLUTIONIZE the contours of future cities' = inovativne konstrukcije = D.

r14.exp: 'Produce energy and food... provide clean water' = produktivni = B.

r15.exp: 'The skyscraper will USE THE SURROUNDINGS TO CREATE SUSTAINABLE LIVING' = maksimalno koristiti okoliš = C.

r16.exp: Text mentions electricity (solar energy), bio fuel (algae), water (wind turbines) — but not CLEAN AIR production specifically = D.

r17.exp: 'Super-compressed MASS TIMBER PANELS' = drvo (timber = drvo) = C.

r18.exp: 'The most demanding task is changing THE CONCEPTS IN OUR HEADS' = promijeniti razmišljanje je izazov = A.

r19.exp: 'Lodges closed, no vacancies, didn't like the look of us. (19)____. Beginning to get worried.' → B: We were directed to other, more remote places, which either didn't exist, or were also full.

r20.exp: 'Track divided into a number of less distinct tracks. (20)____. One was signposted towards the beach.' → D: They were definitely not well-trodden – they were hardly more than faint trails.

r21.exp: 'Tyres spinning, stuck. (21)____. Three wheels hopelessly churning up sand.' → F: Getting out to assess the situation, we saw it was even worse than we had imagined.

r22.exp: 'Heard voices beyond the bushes. (22)____. They greeted us, smiling.' → G: As they drew closer, two boys appeared, followed by an older man.

r23.exp: 'Followed them without knowing who they were. (23)____. Seeing a man emerge I was relieved.' → H: I felt alternating waves of fear and comfort, for I realised that if they wanted to rob or kidnap us, they could have done so already.

r24.exp: 'The Birmingham couple had not been back for a while. (24)____. Our rescuer smiled and shrugged.' → C: No one knew whether they would ever come again.

r25.exp: 'Inactive, LIKE guards protecting a palace' — 'like' za usporedbu (preposition + noun).

r26.exp: 'If anything startling SHOULD happen' — 'should' u kondicionalu za formalnu/literarnu upotrebu: if + should = hipotetska situacija.

r27.exp: 'Give a speech AT a wedding' — prijedlog 'at' za događaje/mjesta.

r28.exp: 'Jump out of THEIR peaceful slumber' — posvojna zamjenica 'their' (the glands' slumber).

r29.exp: 'Fight-or-flight can happen WHEN tension runs high' — 'when' za uzročno-vremensku vezu (surečenica).

r30.exp: 'Or perhaps FLEE such scenes' — 'flee' = pobjeći (glagol bez prijedloga uz objekt; adrenalin pomaže pobjeći).

r31.exp: 'Messes UP your thinking' — frazalni glagol: mess up = pobrkati, poremetiti.

r32.exp: 'You can COUNT ON adrenaline to be there' — fiksna kolokacija: count on = osloniti se na.

r33.exp: 'At LEAST five different things' — fiksni izraz: at least = najmanje, barem.

r34.exp: 'ON average, people do this' — fiksna kolokacija: on average = prosječno.

r35.exp: 'Doing two things AT ONCE' — fiksni izraz: at once = istovremeno.

r36.exp: 'Before starting ANOTHER' — 'another' za još jedan od istog tipa (one job... another job).

r37.exp: 'Don't pay enough ATTENTION/HEED to each task' — fiksne kolokacije: pay attention to = obraćati pozornost; pay heed to = voditi računa.

r38.exp: 'Similar TO each other' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: similar to = sličan nečemu.

r39.exp: 'In ORDER to generate meaningful sentences' — fiksni izraz: in order to = kako bi, radi.

r40.exp: 'Many of US still can't resist' — zamjenica 'us' (we = people in general → of us).
